title: Possible hardcoded API key assignment
description: A variable shaped like api_key/api-key is assigned a long quoted value. Generic shapes like this are weaker evidence than known prefixes — placeholders are common — so every hit needs human review, not blind trust.
remediation: If the value is a real key, revoke it, move it to a secret manager, and load it at runtime. If it is a placeholder, rename it to something obviously fake (e.g. CHANGEME) so future scans stay quiet.
limitation: Generic shape, medium confidence: only assignments with 16+ character quoted values match, and known placeholders are vetoed by the denylist. Short keys, unquoted keys, and keys loaded from files do not match.
